source_findings.content: For the linearized gauge variation A -> A-D_V0 lambda, Q0 changes by an initial endpoint site average minus the terminal transported site average. The terminal transport includes a background loop adjoint that cannot be replaced by the identity merely from regularity. The source calls the preservation approximate.

linearized_residual_dictionary.fixed_data: Use the OLD source blocks, paths, V0 and Ad convention only. This is not yet an old-to-physical centered-block conversion.
linearized_residual_dictionary.notation: For the terminal x_prime in B(c_plus), let T_x=Ad[V0(Gamma_(c_minus,x) union (-c))], H_c=Ad[V0(c)], and lambda_plus(x_prime)=(R_(0,c_plus) lambda)(x_prime). Weights are the original L^-d. The loop composition and adjoints retain the order in the p28 display.
linearized_residual_dictionary.full_linearized_change: Q0(A-D_V0 lambda)(c)-Q0 A(c) = (Q0_prime lambda)(c_minus) - sum_(x_prime in B(c_plus)) L^-d T_x H_c lambda_plus(x_prime).
linearized_residual_dictionary.endpoint_zero_case: When Q0_prime lambda=0 at both endpoints, the same linearized change is -sum L^-d (T_x-I) H_c lambda_plus(x_prime). This is obtained by subtracting H_c times the terminal zero average; no commutation of T_x and H_c is used.
linearized_residual_dictionary.meaning: A zero site-average gauge parameter alone does not authorize dropping this residual in a non-flat source background. One must retain the exact map and its derivative/current, or prove the appropriate cancellation or quantitative comparison on the actual family.
linearized_residual_dictionary.not_inferred: Nonidentity of some loop does not prove this sum is nonzero for a given lambda; central holonomy has trivial adjoint, and cancellations can occur. No actual admissible non-flat numerical counterexample has been supplied. The residual may vanish in special backgrounds. No Ward identity of the full correctly transformed constraint or gauge-invariant observable is refuted.
linearized_residual_dictionary.operator_guard: This Q0 is the leading old path average125, not the full derivative124, not the site average Q0_prime, not the fixed physical P=LQ, not its selected reconstruction C_rec, and not a covariance. The exact transformed constraint has its own endpoint/gauge factors.

mechanism: The background loop transports explain why replacing the gauge can modify the coarse constraint and its current. A covariance import must transport the mean/constraint/current and gauge density together. Matching support alone1814 or dropping to a flat leading average does not perform that operation.
hypotheses_and_limits: Original small-field background and logarithm domains, old paths, branch choices and Lie pairings retained. No same-family inverse bound, actual source regularity witness, old-centered coordinate map, full K_C coverage or nonzero physical normalizer is supplied.
falsifier: For any proposed exact gauge-preservation shortcut, evaluate the displayed residual with its actual admitted background, paths and parameter.
